summary: Implementation plan for the Automated Metadata & Musical Characteristics Mapper and Multi-Version Stream Audition Engine in brickOS Studio. Specifies automatic metadata extraction (BPM, Key, Camelot, LUFS, LRA, True Peak, Vocal Archetypes, Stems, Snippets), Firestore persistence, Nextcloud/Suno stream fallbacks, and Studio version bump to v4.0.
